data.label: contested
data.reason: One source states Southmere received 224 water pumps on 18 September 2025, while another source states 255 water pumps on the same date, indicating conflicting information.

claims.claim: Southmere received 224 water pumps on 18 September 2025.

evidence.quote: The municipal register states that Southmere received exactly 224 water pumps on 18 September 2025.
evidence.reason: Official municipal register directly records the receipt of 224 water pumps on the specified date.
evidence.title: Synthetic Southmere record

evidence.quote: An independently compiled port register states that Southmere received exactly 255 water pumps on 18 September 2025. The two registers disagree.
evidence.reason: Independent port register directly records a different number (255) of water pumps received on the same date, contradicting the municipal register.
evidence.title: Synthetic Southmere record

claims.explanation: The municipal register directly records that Southmere received exactly 224 water pumps on 18 September 2025, supporting the claim as an event. However, an independent port register contradicts this by stating Southmere received 255 water pumps on the same date, indicating a conflict in the records.
claims.missing: Independent verification or reconciliation of the conflicting registers to confirm the exact number of water pumps received by Southmere on 18 September 2025.
